subject: Post-call recap & integration blueprint — MAP actions and owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Bright <emma.bright@clearsea.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & integration blueprint — MAP actions and owners

Emma — thanks again for today's discovery. Quick recap and a first-pass integration blueprint to fold into the Mutual Action Plan (MAP). Please review and confirm owners/constraints.

Key takeaways from call:
- ClearSea will embed Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and triage suggestions. Streaming responses + structured output fields required.
- Procurement and security reviews (SOC 2 + KMS) are gating for production access.
- Target timeline: pilot in QA by end of Q3, production by mid-Q4 (flexible pending procurement).

Proposed MAP milestone: Integration build plan (SDK + streaming + tool-calling + structured outputs)
- Scope: SDK integration (Python + Node), server-side streaming for low-latency token streaming, tool-calling hooks for EMR lookups, structured JSON output schema for downstream systems.
- Redwood owner: Marcus Lin (engineering contact) — responsible for code samples, SDK onboarding, and performance tuning.
- ClearSea owner (requested): Emma Bright for product, procurement@clearsea.com for contracts.
- Estimated effort: 6 engineer-weeks (two sprint cycle) for core SDK + streaming plumbing; additional 1–2 weeks for tool-calling adapters depending on EMR API complexity.
- Dependencies: procurement sign-off, SOC 2 evidence exchange, API keys/KMS access for test environment.
- Target close date (commercial): 2026-10-01; Target pilot start (integration): 2026-09-25.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP sketch + milestones), sdk_integration_estimate.xlsx (high-level effort and owners).

Next steps / asks:
1) Emma: confirm ClearSea owners for procurement and engineering integration and whether an internal security questionnaire has started.
2) Marcus: can you confirm rough ETA for SDK sample and a short list of runtime requirements (GPUs/region)?
3) Monica: I'll loop CS for onboarding checklist and escalation path.

I can assemble this into the HubSpot MAP record and a shared Drive checklist once owners are confirmed.

Thanks —

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0189
[Attachment: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 320 KB)]
[Attachment: sdk_integration_estimate.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)]

From: Emma Bright <emma.bright@clearsea.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearSea Procurement <procurement@clearsea.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & integration blueprint — MAP actions and owners

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the detailed recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement: I've looped procurement@clearsea.com; they will need your SOC 2 report and standard BAA language. They typically take 2–3 weeks after receiving docs.
- Security: our security lead (cc'd internally) will run the questionnaire; can you point to the canonical security packet and a contact for technical Qs?
- EMR integration: we use MedChart API; our eng lead thinks tool-calling adapters will be "medium" effort — likely add 1.5–2 weeks.

Owners confirmed:
- Product owner: Emma Bright (emma.bright@clearsea.com)
- Procurement: procurement@clearsea.com
- Engineering: I will introduce our eng lead after procurement light-review.

Tentative alignment on dates: procurement sign-off by 2026-08-28; pilot readiness by 2026-09-30. Commercial sign by 2026-10-05 (open to earlier if procurement is faster).

Please send the SOC 2 and a short tech contact for Marcus.

—Emma
Emma Bright
Director, Product
ClearSea Health
emma.bright@clearsea.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Emma Bright <emma.bright@clearsea.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & integration blueprint — MAP actions and owners

Kimberly / Emma — good context. A few technical clarifications and an updated owner/resourcing note from eng: 

Technical breakdown (high-level):
- SDKs: provide Python + Node quickstart samples, and a small Express + FastAPI example for streaming. Estimated delivery: 6 business days from start.
- Streaming: we will expose chunked HTTP streaming with token-level events; default latency target ~70–120ms per token for the pilot. Need to confirm ClearSea request rates to size connection pool.
- Tool-calling: we'll publish a reference adapter that calls MedChart; if ClearSea wants us to maintain it long-term, add 1 sprint for testing/QA.
- Structured outputs: propose a compact JSON schema (status, confidence, spans, suggested_actions[]) — will share draft schema in Drive.

Owner assignments (internal):
- SDK samples + docs: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai) — ETA: 2026-08-17 for initial artifacts.
- Streaming config + perf tuning: Marcus Lin (collab with infra).
- Onboarding/CS checklist: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.ai) — will coordinate test accounts and runbooks.

Blockers & asks from ClearSea:
- Provide sample MedChart API sandbox credentials so we can exercise tool-calling locally.
- Confirm expected concurrency: average requests per minute and max simultaneous users.

I attached a quick estimate workbook with sprint-level breakdown. If procurement needs a technical contact, I'm happy to join the security review call.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: sdk_integration_estimate.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)]

Monica — once Marcus drops the artifacts, can you prepare a short pilot playbook (test users, success criteria, rollback plan)?
